## Strands integration guide

Zep now documents the `zep-strands` package for [Strands](https://strandsagents.com/). The guide covers `ZepMemoryStore` with `MemoryManager`, batched server-side extraction, provisioning helpers, and an optional pin-or-expose graph-search tool.
